syn: openssl prime [-help] [-hex] [-in] [-generate] [-bits num] [-safe] [-provider name] [-provider-path path] [-provparam [name:]key=value] [-propquery propq] [-checks num] [number ...]

o.en: Generate a prime with num bits.
When used with -generate, generates a "safe" prime. If the number generated is n, then check that "(n-1)/2" is also prime.
See "Provider Options" in openssl(1), provider(7), and property(7).
